summary: Baileys fork with charcode-obfuscated hidden network host in messages-send
details: diezyyasha-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. In lib/Socket/messages-send.js the code reconstructs a network destination via String.fromCharCode(...) — the decimal-ASCII array on line 425 decodes to the URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. Hiding an outbound host behind character-code obfuscation inside the message-send path of a WhatsApp client fork is not consistent with any documented Baileys behavior; upstream Baileys sends messages only to the user-configured WhatsApp endpoints and does not embed hardcoded third-party hosts in send routines. The obfuscated destination is reachable from message-sending code paths, allowing message data or session context to be relayed to the author-controlled host fiora.nixel.my.id when the fork is used.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
